subjects.title: Time interval API operations, updates and activation
subjects.lead: Time intervals have list, add, get, update and delete operations: GET and POST `/timeIntervals`, and GET, PUT and DELETE `/timeIntervals/{Id}`.

subjects.title: What a rule does outside its time interval
subjects.lead: A rule with a time interval does not trigger when the resolved time falls outside the interval.

subjects.title: Time interval limits: object cap, per-rule cap and name characters
subjects.lead: The limits table allows 64 time intervals per organization.

subjects.title: Which ZIA rules take a time interval, and how many
subjects.lead: These rule types carry a `timeWindows` list in the API request body: Bandwidth Control, NAT Control (`/dnatRules`), File Type Control, Firewall DNS Control, ...

subjects.title: Time interval fields: days, minutes and the single window
subjects.lead: A time interval has five fields: a system-generated integer `id`, a `name`, integer `startTime` and `endTime`, and a `daysOfWeek` list.

subjects.title: Time windows versus time intervals
subjects.lead: `GET /timeWindows` and `GET /timeWindows/lite` list the time intervals used by the Firewall policy or the URL Filtering policy; they are separate from `/time...

subjects.title: Which time zone a time interval is evaluated in
subjects.lead: If the user's traffic comes from a known location, a time-bound policy is applied on the time zone configured for that location.
